description: Tránsito acumulado is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Caminos y Puentes Federales de Ingresos y Servicios Conexos (CAPUFE). Datos sobre los movimientos mensuales que capta de la Red Propia, desagregados por tipo de infraestructura y automóvil. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Caminos y Puentes Federales de Ingresos y Servicios Conexos (CAPUFE). Its tags are carretera, carro, infraestructura transporte, movilidad, red carretera federal. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-11-10 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
